title: First Letter That Stands Alone
statement:
A word is written in lowercase letters. A position is lonely if its letter does not appear anywhere else in the word. Find the first lonely position.

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print the 1-based position of the first lonely letter. If every letter appears at least twice, print `-1`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 100000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
